name: Arachidyl behenate
description: Arachidyl behenate (CAS 42233-14-7 ), also known as icosanyl docosanoate, is a long-chain fatty acid ester derived from arachidyl alcohol and behenic acid. It functions as a structuring wax, rheology modifier, and lubricant across personal care, industrial coatings, and polymer applications. In cosmetic formulations, it builds solid structure in stick products, lip balms, and emollients. It provides a smooth, non-greasy skin feel that supports premium texture positioning for high-end consumer goods. Industrial lubricant formulators use it as a solid lubricant additive where high-melting wax esters are needed. It is particularly effective at reducing friction under load in demanding mechanical environments. In coatings and sealants, it acts as a surface modifier and slip agent. This improves mar resistance and enhances the overall application properties of finished films and protective layers. Polymer and plastics compounders incorporate it as an internal or external lubricant to aid processing. It helps reduce melt adhesion during extrusion and improves the flow of materials during manufacturing. Arachidyl behenate is supplied as a white to off-white solid, typically in flake or powder form. It is available in cosmetic-grade quality meeting personal care industry purity standards for global compliance. The material is also available in technical grade for industrial applications requiring bulk quantities.
